_note: B-23. Ticket write levers on the mock PSA state (the client's tickets in the mock tenant file). Mock only; no real PSA is called.

levers.name: ticket.link
levers.description: Link two of the client's own tickets as duplicate, related or one outage group, on both tickets. Mock of a PSA ticket relation.

ticket_id.description: The ticket to link, e.g. T-5116

related_id.description: The other ticket of the same client, e.g. T-5117

link_type.description: How the two tickets are related

impact.L1: Two people with the same problem are worked together, so neither waits behind a second copy; a wrong link could close a ticket that was a different problem.
impact.L2: The client's tickets are tidier and a widespread issue shows as one event; a wrong link hides a separate problem inside another ticket.
impact.L3: Fewer duplicate tickets are worked twice and an outage is one incident for the whole desk; every link is a registered, approved and audited change.
impact.L4: Tickets are only ever linked inside one client, so one office's problem is never attached to another's.
